tools.name: search
tools.description: Search ALL configured note platforms at once (Obsidian, Feishu, OneNote, Yuque, Notion, Evernote). Returns merged results from every platform the user has configured. Supports filtering by platform, sorting by date, and limiting results.

query.description: Search keyword across all note platforms

from_platform.description: Optional: filter by platform(s), comma-separated. E.g. 'obsidian,feishu' to only search Obsidian and Feishu.

sort_by.description: Optional: sort results by date. 'date' = ascending, '-date' = descending.

limit.description: Optional: max total results to return (default: no limit).
